paragraphs.text: Metronome is the codename for a three-year story arc running from Wilds of Eldraine through Reality Fracture . It consists of the Omenpath Arc , the Dragonstorm Arc , and the Echoverse Arc . Metronome takes place after the Phyrexian Arc and centers on Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse .

Metronome begins with the Omenpath Arc, which consists of the sets Wilds of Eldraine , The Lost Caverns of Ixalan , Murders at Karlov Manor , and Outlaws of Thunder Junction . This arc introduces Kellan , who travels the Multiverse via Omenpaths in search of his father Oko . The storyline deals with the consequences of the New Phyrexian Invasion , including the Desparkening and the emergence of Omenpaths.

The Dragonstorm Arc consists of the sets Bloomburrow , Duskmourn: House of Horror , Aetherdrift , and Tarkir: Dragonstorm . Dragonstorms run wild on the plane of Tarkir , unleashing dragons on other planes through Omenpaths. Meanwhile, Jace and Vraska travel the Multiverse with Loot . The arc concludes with Jace's apparent death as he attempts to enact his plan in the Meditation Realm .
Metronome's final storyline, the Echoverse Arc, arc consists of Edge of Eternities , Lorwyn Eclipsed , Secrets of Strixhaven , and the climactic event set Reality Fracture .
